cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I pay the builder, sign that my fence can stay on our boundary. Use the plain wording I taught you when we ran the allotment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A shorter answer than you used to give. Now write 'can stay' beside your name; leave 'suppose' out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then date it today. You finally spotted a limit worth writing down. If your answer changes, add the new date; don't rub out this one.

reason: Use actual taught habits to determine apology order, record completeness, responsibility or recruitment. Preserve distinct motives and useful B contributions; conceal priority through whole-account requests rather than merely declaring neutrality.
